items.title: Dhanlaxmi Bank posts Rs 43.5 crore profit in Q4
items.description: Dhanlaxmi Bank's net profit surged 50% to ₹43.5 crore in Q4 FY26, with operating profit reaching ₹113.7 crore. The Kerala-based bank also saw its gross NPA ratio improve significantly to 1.9% from 2.9% a year ago.

items.title: New launches, capacity hike to lift Maruti Suzuki facing a war squeeze
items.description: Maruti Suzuki's March quarter net profit declined due to mark-to-market losses, input costs, and production constraints. The company is expanding capacity and expects margin improvement by FY30, driven by SUV launches and EV growth. Despite short-term pressures, FY26 saw record volumes and sales.
